Verify Now Blog > Holiday Schedule of Mid-Autumn Festival 2026 Holiday Schedule of Mid-Autumn Festival 2026 by: Mila Sep 11,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News Dear PCBWayers: Thank you for your continued support and trust in us throughout the year. To celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival 2026, the PCBWay factory will be on holiday during this period. Orders can still be placed during the holiday and will be processed in order after production resumes. Please plan your orders according to the holiday schedule below. The PCB factories holiday schedule: 1.Standard PCB: Arrange Production 2.Stencil: Sep. 26th~ 27th. 3.Advanced PCB: Sep. 25th~ 27th. 4.PCB Assembly: Sep. 25th. 5.CNC | 3D Printing: Sep. 25th~ 26th. 6.PCB Design: Sep. 25th~ 27th.
